definition: Seven-layer reference model for network communication: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.
Connection-oriented transport protocol with a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) and guaranteed, ordered delivery.
Connectionless transport protocol: no handshake or delivery guarantee, so it's fast. Used for DNS lookups, VoIP and streaming.
Translates names like example.com into IP addresses. Uses UDP 53 for queries and TCP 53 for zone transfers.
